title: Owner-conditioned whole forms select local referents
summary: Test whether a complete recurring whole keeps a stable semantic role while its referent is selected by the admitted visual owner, rather than denoting one portable object across the manuscript.

design.mechanism: The owner supplies a local referent namespace; the whole contributes a role and successor constraint within that owner.
design.unit: admitted complete-whole occurrences with an exact visual owner and one following field
design.contrast: same whole across two owners versus within-owner matched occurrences, controlling register and position
design.prediction: Successor role distributions differ by owner for the same whole, while each owner retains an internally reproducible successor pattern; a portable-object model predicts no owner interaction.
design.falsifier: Held-owner interaction disappears after position/register controls, or within-owner successors are not more coherent than cross-owner successors.
design.scope: admitted visual-owner selectors and cached text only; feasibility_unknown for sufficient repeated wholes per owner
design.related: GDT790/GDT791 owner overlays and GDT415 owner expansion are predecessors; this is a bounded interaction test, not a new owner atlas
